global_issues.title: Middle East Uncertainty Persists Over Hormuz and Oil Flows
global_issues.note: Confirmed: Houthis claimed Aug 9 drone strike on Saudi Aramco Jazan refinery (fire extinguished, no major damage), Iran FM Araghchi denied direct US talks (CNBC 2026-08-09). However, briefing omits a notable escalation from Aug 8: Iran's Supreme National Security Council stated the Strait will not reopen until the US 'corrects its behavior' and issued new demands — this hardens the outlook slightly beyond what the briefing conveys.

global_issues.title: July Job Losses Temper Fed Rate-Hike Expectations
global_issues.note: Confirmed: July NFP showed -23,000 jobs vs +80-83k expected, unemployment 4.1%, initially cutting Sept hike odds (57%→44% per some trackers). However, by Aug 9-10 other prediction markets/analysts (Kalshi, Chase) show odds swinging back toward a possible Sept hike (up to ~65% in some readings) on Iran-conflict-driven energy/inflation concerns — the briefing's one-directional 'tempered hike odds' framing is now only partially current.

global_issues.title: Nvidia China AI Chip Share Forecast to Fall Sharply to 8%
global_issues.note: Confirmed via MarketScale Aug 9 and corroborating outlets (FourWeekMBA, Techloy): Bernstein forecasts Nvidia's China AI chip share collapsing from ~40% to ~8% by end of 2026 as Huawei's Ascend 950 scales, driven by export controls. Note this is a restated/older Bernstein forecast (also covered back in June 2026) rather than new information as of Aug 9.

grok_report.summary: The three global issues and stock closing prices are factually accurate and traceable to real sources, but the briefing is silent on two developing threads that shifted after it was generated context (Aug 8 Iranian hardline Hormuz statement, and re-firming Fed hike odds from Iran-driven energy inflation), both of which soften the otherwise upbeat framing. Sector/mood characterizations are technically defensible but potentially misleading without clearer distinction between intraday price action and structural trend classification.
